case_summary: An intrusion involving EtherRAT and TukTuk malware, leading to the deployment of The Gentlemen ransomware across a network.

tools_used.purpose: Memory analysis for identifying malware and lateral movement activities
Pattern matching to detect known malicious signatures in memory dumps and files
Log file analysis, including EVTX logs, for timeline reconstruction
Forensic image analysis of disk images

source_title: Flash Alert: EtherRat and TukTuk C2 End in The Gentleman Ransomware - The DFIR Report
